page.content:
The 2018 independent show that proved AEW, later the Wembley stadium event.

How All In connects

  • Topic: AEW — The 2018 All In show proved the market that became AEW.
  • Location: Wembley Stadium — Later All In cards are staged at Wembley Stadium.
  • Character: Bryan Danielson — Danielson won the world title at All In in Wembley.

What is All In?

All In 2018 at the Sears Centre was the sold-out independent card that convinced Tony Khan to fund AEW. All In later became AEW's stadium show at Wembley Stadium.

Key threads lead to AEW, Wembley Stadium and Bryan Danielson.
